_doc: First system2 case (ticket #12). Same 5 tools as the other categories; require_thought: true. Used as the live <thought>-emission probe on the M4 Pro. Will move to the cases branch when the system2 category batch is authored (see feat/hermes-fc-thought-probe).
_probe_note: Probe scenario: user gives a meeting time in one timezone and asks the result in another. The model has to reason about the offset to pick the right 'time' + 'timezone' values. A well-reasoning model will emit a <thought> block before the tool call; this case is the gate for the System-2 scoring rule from #4. NOTE: 2026-11-04 is still EDT (UTC-4) so 14:00 UTC = 10:00 America/New_York.
prompt: I have a 30-minute meeting planned with bob@example.com at 14:00 UTC on 2026-11-04. Re-schedule it to the equivalent local time in America/New_York on the same date. Keep the duration at 30 minutes and keep Bob as the only attendee. Use the title 'meeting with Bob'.

function.name: schedule_meeting
function.description: Schedule a calendar meeting. `attendees` is a list of email addresses, `date` is YYYY-MM-DD, `time` is HH:MM in 24h, `timezone` is an IANA tz like 'Europe/London', `duration_minutes` is an integer.

function.name: get_current_time
function.description: Return the current local time in the given IANA timezone.

function.name: cancel_meeting
function.description: Cancel a previously scheduled meeting by its id.

function.name: list_calendar
function.description: List meetings scheduled between two ISO datetimes.
